title: Schr\"odinger-Bass Bridge Barycenter Models for Measure-Valued Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.29227v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Barycenter models, based on stochastic and deterministic optimal transport bridges between probability measures, have proven to be useful for supervised and unsupervised learning for (probability) measure-valued data. In this paper, we utilize the directional asymmetry and dual drift-diffusion control arising in the recently proposed Schr\"odinger-Bass Bridge (SBB) between two measures, and propose \textit{SBB-encoder}, \textit{SBB-decoder}, \textit{SBB-symmetric}, and \textit{SBB-Markovian} barycenter models. For each of these novel models, our first theoretical result establishes the existence of the SBB-barycenter under mild assumptions. Our second theoretical result characterizes the decoder SBB-barycenter of Gaussians where we show that for Gaussian input measures, the decoder formulation admits a Gaussian minimizer, reducing barycenter computation to a finite-dimensional optimization and yielding a compact algorithm. translated_title: 面向测度值数据的薛定谔-巴斯桥重心模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.29227v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于概率测度之间随机与确定性最优传输桥的重心模型，已被证明对（概率）测度值数据的有监督和无监督学习十分有用。在本文中，我们利用最近提出的两测度间薛定谔-巴斯桥中出现的方向不对称性及对偶漂移-扩散控制，提出了SBB-编码器、SBB-解码器、SBB-对称和SBB-马尔可夫四种重心模型。针对每一个新模型，我们的第一个理论结果在温和假设下证明了SBB重心的存在性。我们的第二个理论结果刻画了高斯分布的解码器SBB重心：我们证明对于高斯输入测度，解码器形式存在高斯极小化器，从而将重心计算归结为有限维优化，并得到一个紧凑的算法。对于一般的…
tldr: 本文利用薛定谔-巴斯桥的方向不对称性与对偶漂移-扩散控制，提出四种新型测度值数据重心模型，并从理论上证明了这些重心的存在性，且证明高斯输入下解码器形式存在高斯最优解，可将重心计算化为有限维优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes four novel barycenter models (SBB-encoder, SBB-decoder, SBB-symmetric, SBB-Markovian) for measure-valued data based on the Schrödinger-Bass Bridge's directional asymmetry and dual drift-diffusion control, proving their existence and showing that the decoder formulation admits a Gaussian minimizer for Gaussian inputs, reducing computation to finite-dimensional optimization.
